notes.title: Patch: 1.4.6
notes.content:
Another small patch today to improve the stability of the game. 

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crashed caused when a player surrenders as a prop
[*] Added Coyote Time for props (improved jumping)
[*] Fixed purple outline staying on objects it shouldn't
[*] Removed the requirement for 3+ players to be in the lobby to gain XP. Now you only need 2 players
[*] Increased the level cap to 100
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the hunter to be super slow
[*] Significantly reduced the props ability to jump on walls
[*] Fixed various bugs on multiple maps
[*] Added Discord Rich Presence (Speaking of, join our [url=https://discord.gg/RCnCQeFcVJ]Discord![/url])
[*] Added a new achievement "It's Bear Time". Find a hidden bear and transform into it as a prop to unlock. There is a bear hidden on every map.
[*] Improved crash logging. If you are having issues with crashing please join the [url=https://discord.gg/RCnCQeFcVJ]Discord[/url] and let me know!
[/list]

The next update will include some new content, but will take longer to develop. 

Stay tuned!
- River

notes.title: Patch: 1.3.9
notes.content:
Small patch today to fix up some smaller bugs and improve movement. I'll be looking into fixing the leveling system very soon!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Wall Collisions on the Dungeons map
[*] Fixed clients not being teleported properly when leaving the game zone
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed Hunters to sprint while aiming down sights
[*] Fixed some broken terrain textures (Farm and Kingdom maps)
[*] Improved Collisions on the City map
[*] Improved sprinting mechanics
[*] You can now aim while jumping as a Hunter
[*] Props are now more controllable while in the air
[*] Added some UI to show when you can interact with objects (props, doors, elevators, etc.)
[/list]


[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Leveling system is broken
[*] Terrain textures on Winter Kingdom map are broken
[*] Opening the scoreboard stops player movement
[/list]
[i]Did I miss any bugs? Let me know here or on[/i] [url=https://discord.gg/RCnCQeFcVJ]Discord[/url]!


Have fun! 
- River

notes.title: Ember Light Games Takes Over Development of Peekaboo
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I know its been a long time since any news has come from Peekaboo, but today that changes. [b]Ember Light Games[/b] will be taking over development of Peekaboo, and will continue to support the game with new content, bug fixes, and quality of life changes going forward.


[i]I'm very excited to be able to work on Peekaboo, as I've enjoyed the game for many years now, and this will give me a great opportunity to sharpen my skills as a developer. My current plan is to focus on some bug fixes and quality of life changes to begin with, while I get comfortable working on the project. I also want to spend more time playing the game, and reading feedback from players to better understand where the high priority tasks are. If you have any feedback, feel free to let me know either here in the Steam Forums, or on the Ember Light Discord. I'll see you in game![/i]
[url=https://discord.gg/RCnCQeFcVJ]Ember Light Games Discord[/url]

- River, Ember Light Games


[b]With this announcement comes the first new patch:[/b]

[list]
[*] New Map: Pirate Lagoon!
[*] Optimized collisions on most maps
[*] The player now always teleports back into the play area when glitching out of the map
[*] Made some tweaks to prop movement to help stabilize and balance the physics
[/list]

notes.title: Release! Patch 1.0.0.0
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Peekaboo is officially released. We have prepared a lot of new content and fixed a bunch of bugs.[/b][/u][/h1]

[h1][b]NEW:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Added new map - Military;[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34697537/e5fd3d6367a652e0e7b810bc16be4bee7d6fbf61.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Added first-person mode for hunters, which you can choose when creating a server;[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34697537/09e514964774d4aec3ce6ddce22a4e86a9992029.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Remade shooting mode of hunters;[/b]
[*] [b]Shooting no longer does not depend from ping;[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]CHANGED:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved communication with the database;
[*] Improved server search;
[*] Changed team balance;
[*] Fixed numerous bugs;
[/list]

[h1][b]EVENT[/b][/h1]

[b]Dear players, we have prepared for you an event in the game in honor of the official release of the game.

— For the victory in the round the amount of experience increases by 50%;

— For the disclosure of props the experience gain is increased by 60%;[/b]

notes.title: Global update 0.2.0.0

tags.feature: - New: Added skill system. Now for participation in the game you can get experience. When each level is reached, 1 skill point is awarded (2 point at the fifth level).
A skills panel has appeared in the main menu where you can spend your points on researching new game abilities.
At the moment, 3 skills are available for each class. In the future, this system will be greatly improved.
- New: Added new skill for props - invisibility, which allows you to merge with the terrain for a short time;
- New: Added a new skill for hunters - the web. When using the ability, an area appears near the hunter, which reduces the speed of all props by 30%;
- New: Now the skills that were previously available to all players initially, need to be studied separately in the skills panel (shadow and bomb);
- New: On all maps the graphic component has been improved;
- New: The Wild West map has been almost completely redesigned;
- New: Map "Pirate Bay" has acquired new textures of the earth;
- New: Map "Viking Village" has acquired new land textures;
- New: Highlighting added to the borders of the maps;
- New: Updated textures on the maps in the menu;

tags.bug: - Fixed: Numerous bugs and problems with collisions of objects;
- Fixed: The collision with rocks was fixed on the "Pirate Bay" map (there is no way to hide inside);
- Fixed: When falling under the ground, cyclically throws to the surface;
- Fixed: Not nicknames are displayed above all hunters;
- Fixed: Information about the disclosure of the props is not lost;
